scope: FP-SLOTIDX-SLOTRES-CUT: break T-20260902-041 signoff setup top fp_exec slot_idx[2] -> slot_result_r[26] (49 levels, 25.478 ns, -5.200 ns) by adding an iterative FDIV/FSQRT final pre-round pipeline stage in scalar_unit; keep FP/NEON raw-bit, FPCR/FPSR, FCMP NZCV, FP->GPR, single-outstanding/order semantics and only add fixed pipeline latency.

implementation.summary: In release FP_ITER=1 g_iter, added IT_FIN pipeline state and div_pre/div_pre_lo/div_pre_hi/sqrt_pre/sqrt_pre_lo/sqrt_pre_hi fp_pre_t registers. The iterative FDIV/FSQRT completion path no longer computes the full div_finish/sqrt_finish_iter (unpack + special + round_pack) directly to scalar_result in one combinational cone. It now captures the unpacked/special decision plus quotient/root quotient in the completion cycle, then performs only finish_pre/round_pack in IT_FIN. This cuts the remaining slot operand mux -> iterative finish -> slot_result_r path while preserving all raw-bit semantics.

semantics.raw_bit: unchanged; div_finish_pre/sqrt_finish_pre and finish_pre use the same unpack/FZ/special/round rules
semantics.commit_order: unchanged; single outstanding fp_exec transaction and one held response
semantics.fpsr_fpcr: unchanged; FPCR snapshot at acceptance and FPSR sticky OR preserved
semantics.fcmp_nzcv: unchanged; CMP remains on existing pp_other path
semantics.kill_reset: new div_pre*/sqrt_pre* cleared on reset/kill with other pipeline registers; IT_FIN returns to IDLE when valid drops

implementation.notes: Only iterative FDIV/FSQRT latencies increase. No DSP added; the new storage is a small set of fp_pre_t registers (six per scalar unit).
